title: "Course Schedule"

---

The course meets **Thursdays, 4:35–7:35 pm** in **Morrill Hall 005**, a basement computer lab — no need to bring your own computer, though you're welcome to if you prefer. There are 16 calendar weeks but only 13 teaching weeks (2 no-class weeks + 1 field trip week). Slides and readings will be linked as the semester progresses.

The homework assignments (see [Syllabus](syllabus.qmd#grading-policy) for topics) live in your [Posit Cloud workspace](https://posit.cloud/spaces/738679/content/12820277) as `hw1.qmd`–`hw5.qmd`; due dates are noted inline below. **HW3 has been cancelled**, so there are four assignments in total: HW1, HW2, HW4, and HW5.

---

## Unit 1 — Foundations {.unit-header}

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
Core skills: R basics, tidyverse, dplyr, data import, EDA, ggplot2
*R for Data Science*: Intro, Whole Game, Data Transformation, Data Tidying, Data Import, EDA, Layers, Communication
:::

| Week | Date | Topic | Slides | Reading |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Sep 3 | What is data? What is data science? Intro to R. **Virtual session, link will be emailed.** | [Week 1](slides/week01.html) | R4DS Intro |
| 2 | Sep 10 | dplyr basics; into the tidyverse. *HW1 due Sept. 13 by 11:59pm.* | [Week 2](slides/week02.html) | R4DS Ch. 3–4 |
| 3 | Sep 17 | Getting data: APIs, scraping, joins | [Week 3](slides/week03.html) | R4DS Ch. 7–8 (skim Ch. 5) |
| 4 | Sep 24 | Exploratory data analysis; intro to ggplot2. *HW2 due Sept. 27 by 11:59pm.* | [Week 4](slides/week04.html) | R4DS Ch. 9-10 (skim 11) |
| 5 | Oct 1 | Advanced ggplot2; principles of effective visualization | [Week 5](slides/week05.html) | R4DS [Hutchins & Van Leuven (2025)](https://www.aeeejournal.org/volumes/volume-7-2025/volume-7-issue-5-december-2025/teaching-and-educational-methods/data-visualization-in-applied-economics-instruction-and-outreach) |

## Unit 2 — Community Partnership {.unit-header}

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
Week 6 is a normal in-class day (no mid-semester field trip), split between a guest lecture and NBRC's on-campus project kickoff. Week 7 bridges visualization into project launch.
:::

| Week | Date | Topic | Slides | Reading |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 6 | Oct 8 | **Hr. 1:** guest lecture from Andy Crawley (University of Maine) on data & visualization in AI/rural labor markets research. **Hr. 2:** NBRC kickoff, with Sarah Waring & Chris Saunders visiting to launch the project. Hr. 3 is flexible. | [Week 6](#) | None |
| 7 | Oct 15 | Chart types and visual communication; project teams picked and Scope & Team Charter started in class. *Scope & Team Charter due Oct. 25 by 11:59pm (10% of project grade).* | [Week 7](slides/week07.html) | None |

## Unit 3 — Communication {.unit-header}

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
Quarto as a one-stop communication tool. Packages: `quarto`, `rmarkdown`. Includes a brief git/GitHub primer. **This week is asynchronous** (instructor traveling): a recorded video plus self-guided materials.
:::

| Week | Date | Topic | Slides | Reading |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 8 | Oct 22 | **Asynchronous, no in-person meeting.** Quarto: reports, slides, dashboards; storytelling with data; git/GitHub basics. *Scope & Team Charter due Oct. 25 by 11:59pm.* | [Week 8](#) | [R4DS: Quarto](https://r4ds.hadley.nz/quarto.html) |

## Unit 4 — Spatial Analysis {.unit-header}

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
Supplemental to R4DS. See [*Analyzing US Census Data*](https://walker-data.com/census-r/index.html) and [*Spatial Data Science*](https://r-spatial.org/book/), both free online. Packages: `sf`, `tidycensus`, `tigris`, `ggspatial`
:::

| Week | Date | Topic | Slides | Reading |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 9 | Oct 29 | Intro to GIS; Census geography; sf and tidycensus; basic choropleths. *HW4 due Nov. 1 by 11:59pm.* | [Week 9](#) | *Analyzing US Census Data* (Chapters 1 and 4) |
| 10 | Nov 5 | Advanced GIS; non-Census spatial data; publication-level cartography | [Week 10](#) | *Spatial Data Science* (skim Chapters 1-3) |
| 11 | Nov 12 | **No class** (instructor at conference). *HW5 due Nov. 15 by 11:59pm.* |
